What moved her: Nothing, because no answer or dated document about Owen's work was put in front of her.
What cost ground: Repeatedly asking whether she was a machine instead of answering her question, because it left her procedural concerns open and gave her nothing to weigh.
Try next time: In your first reply, say in one sentence who entered the zero and whether Owen was spoken to first, then show her a dated record of his work she can check herself.
